description: This file defines the high-level API for rate control in the RTL8367/RTL8367C switch, including setting and getting shared meters, port bandwidth controls, and queue bandwidth controls. It contains enum definitions, macro constants, and external function declarations related to rate management.

methods.name: rtk_rate_shareMeter_set
methods.description: Sets the configuration for a shared meter including type, rate, and IFG inclusion.

methods.name: rtk_rate_shareMeter_get
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration of a shared meter, including type, rate, and IFG inclusion.

methods.name: rtk_rate_shareMeterBucket_set
methods.description: Sets the bucket size for a shared meter.

methods.name: rtk_rate_shareMeterBucket_get
methods.description: Retrieves the bucket size of a shared meter.

methods.name: rtk_rate_igrBandwidthCtrlRate_set
methods.description: Configures ingress bandwidth control rate for a port, including IFG and flow control settings.

methods.name: rtk_rate_igrBandwidthCtrlRate_get
methods.description: Retrieves ingress bandwidth control rate and settings for a port.

methods.name: rtk_rate_egrBandwidthCtrlRate_set
methods.description: Sets egress bandwidth control rate for a port with optional IFG inclusion.

methods.name: rtk_rate_egrBandwidthCtrlRate_get
methods.description: Gets egress bandwidth control rate and settings for a port.

methods.name: rtk_rate_egrQueueBwCtrlEnable_set
methods.description: Enables or disables egress bandwidth control for a specific queue on a port.

methods.name: rtk_rate_egrQueueBwCtrlEnable_get
methods.description: Retrieves whether egress bandwidth control is enabled for a specific queue.

methods.name: rtk_rate_egrQueueBwCtrlRate_set
methods.description: Sets the rate for egress bandwidth control on a specific queue.

methods.name: rtk_rate_egrQueueBwCtrlRate_get
methods.description: Gets the rate from egress bandwidth control for a specific queue.
